title: Villanueva condemns Houthi attacks that injured Filipinos in Riyadh

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Joel Villanueva on Tuesday condemned the Houthi attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, that reportedly injured four Filipinos, three of whom required intensive care. According to the senator, stronger government assistance system for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) caught in emergencies abroad is needed. “We strongly condemn the successive Houthi attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which have claimed innocent lives and injured several others,” Villanueva said in a statement.
